We are seeking experts with a strong background in Data Science, Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help our clients solve their most pressing business challenges through data-driven innovation.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of data science, AI, and cloud engineering, leveraging the Azure ecosystem including Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI to build and deploy scalable, production-ready AI and ML solutions.
You will play a pivotal role in designing predictive models, experimenting with generative AI, and developing intelligent systems that enhance decision-making, automate processes, and unlock business value.


Identify, collect, and integrate valuable data sources across structured and unstructured environments.
Design and implement machine learning and AI solutions using Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, and Azure AI Services.
Develop, train, and deploy models for predictive analytics, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and generative AI use cases.
Build and automate MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, delivery, and model monitoring within Azure.
Perform feature engineering, data wrangling, and model evaluation at scale using Spark and Databricks/Snowflake.
Leverage Azure Cognitive Services and Azure OpenAI to integrate pre-trained AI models into enterprise applications.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex analytical insights into business strategies and operational solutions.
Present data-driven insights through impactful visualizations and storytelling using Power BI and Python visualization libraries.
Ensure compliance with AI ethics, governance, and responsible-AI principles.
Key Skills Requirements
5+ years of experience in Data Science, AI, or Applied Machine Learning roles.
Proven experience with Azure cloud technologies, including Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Cognitive Services.
Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark).
Solid understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning techniques (e.g., regression, classification, NLP, CNNs, RNNs, transformers).
Practical experience in LLMs (Large Language Models) and Generative AI frameworks such as OpenAI or Azure OpenAI.
Expertise in SQL and data querying across relational and cloud data sources.
Familiarity with MLOps tools (MLflow, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for model versioning, deployment, and governance.
Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Plotly, Matplotlib) and storytelling for business impact.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field.

Seeking an innovative Generative AI Engineer to develop advanced AI models that enhance our digital products and services.
Responsibilities :
Design and implement machine learning algorithms and tools for generative models.
Research and apply advanced techniques in the field of AI to solve complex problems.
Collaborate with product teams to integrate AI capabilities.
Stay up-to-date with the latest AI trends and methodologies.
Requirements and Qualifications :
PhD or Master s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field.
Experience with AI generative models, including GPT, BERT, and other transformer-based architectures.
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Why Join Us :
Be at the cutting edge of AI technologies.
Collaborate with leading experts in a supportive and innovative environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits, including substantial investment in your professional development.

Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop scalable and efficient AI and ML models.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI and ML solutions into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.
Conduct research and stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and ML.
Implement automated testing and deployment scripts.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and provide technical solutions.
Job Requirements
Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

Role & responsibilities

Handson engineer to build Pythonbased GenAI and AWS Bedrock solutions, contributing to RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and production-ready AI features under senior guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Develop GenAI features and workflows using Python and AWS Bedrock
Implement RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, grounding)
Build single/multi-step agent workflows using LangChain / LangGraph
Integrate LLMs with APIs, tools, and enterprise applications
Write tested, maintainable Python code with CI/CD pipelines
Monitor basic latency, token usage, and cost metrics
Collaborate with architects, seniors, and QA teams

MustHave Skills

Python - Core concepts: OOP, typing, modules, pytest/unittest, fixtures, basic async

AWS Bedrock - Model invocation (Claude/Titan, etc.), Knowledge bases or retrieval integration, basic understanding of guardrails & access controls

Generative AI - Prompting (system, few-shot), RAG types and approaches, Basic evaluation awareness, LangChain / LangGraph , Simple agent flows and routing

DevOps Basics - Git, PRs, CI pipelines, Docker basics, artifacts

Good to Have

Vector DB exposure (OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, etc.), Kubernetes awareness, ML basics (metrics, crossval, leakage awareness), Understand requirements clearly, Good communication and learning mindset & Team-oriented execution.

Note: Apply only if you are available in Bangalore or ready to relocate .

Experience with dotnet full stack and Gen ai is mandatory.




Preferred candidate profile

Full Time, Remote.
Position Overview:
We are seeking a talented and passionate Generative AI & Copilot Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy AI-powered copilots and assistants that enhance user productivity, streamline workflows, and enable intelligent automation. You will work closely with product managers, data scientists, and backend engineers to build intelligent user experiences powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).
Responsibilities:
Build and deploy custom Generative AI copilots using LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.)
Design prompt flows, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and fine-tuning strategies for domain-specific tasks
Integrate copilots into web/internal platforms via APIs or SDKs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify AI use cases and optimize AI-driven user experiences
Evaluate LLM performance using real-world data and improve response accuracy, tone, and relevance
Monitor latency, cost, and reliability metrics for deployed AI agents
Stay updated on GenAI tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Create technical documentation and support internal adoption/scaling
Ensure compliance with ethical AI usage, data privacy, and security best practices

Requirements:
Bachelor s or Master s in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, or related field
2 5 years of experience in backend or AI/ML engineering, with recent LLM-based work
Strong programming skills in Python (JavaScript/TypeScript is a bonus)
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or Hugging Face APIs
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector search
Knowledge of RAG architecture, model fine-tuning, and inference optimization
Comfortable with APIs, databases, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Strong analytical and debugging skills with a product mindset
Excellent communication and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
Bonus (Preferred Experience):
Background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or digital risk protection
Experience building or integrating AI copilots for security operations such as:
Phishing detection
Alert triage
Threat summarization
Understanding of how Generative AI can assist in:
Automating incident response and SOC workflows
Enriching IOCs and TTPs with contextual analysis
Generating executive summaries from technical logs and threat reports
Simulating adversarial behavior (e.g., prompt-injection or red teaming models)
Assisting analysts with real-time queries using natural language interfaces
Join us and help shape the future of human-AI collaboration through powerful copilots that make everyday tasks smarter, faster, and more human.

We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer with 412 years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in building and deploying production-grade GenAI solutions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI Agents, Python, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
The role involves designing end-to-end GenAI solutions, developing RAG pipelines and AI agents, integrating models such as OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, and building AI services using Python and FastAPI/Flask.
The candidate will work with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search and deploy scalable AI applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Responsibilities also include LLM evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, security, responsible AI, performance optimization, and taking GenAI solutions from POC to production.

Position: Generative AI Engineer

Job Type: Permanent

Experience: 10+ Years

Location: Hyderabad , Bangalore

Notice Period: Immediate




Interview Mode: Face-to-Face(F2F) interview on this Saturday , 19th September




Job Requirements

Candidate should have 10 to 15 years of experience.
Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, fine-tuning, etc., using tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, etc.
Clear understanding of Model Context Protocols, A2A Protocols, Agent Developer Kit, and working experience with LLMs.
Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI solutions, including evaluation and optimization; Machine Learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Extensive hands-on data science experience, leveraging machine learning and data science tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.
Experience with DevOps tools: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD Pipelines, GitHub/GitLab, GitOps, GitHub Actions, Jira, Jenkins, CircleCI, Datadog, Slack.
Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike.
5+ years of engineering and technical deployment experience in a customer-facing setup.
Should have scoped and delivered complex systems in rapid and ambiguous environments.
Delivered production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or similar stacks.
Understand how AI model behaviour affects product experience.
Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders.
Flag risks early and seek attention according to the severity.

Key Responsibilities

Help clients integrate and adopt the offerings; demonstrate the impact/outcomes the offerings committed to, such as KPI improvements, and help clients succeed.
Embed within the client landscape, understand their domain, and co-develop solutions with the core product engineering teams.
Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from prototype to stable release.
Build bespoke AI and transformative agentic AI solutions.
Perform technical debugging and root cause analysis.
Rapid prototyping.
Implement and administer best practices.

Position: Generative AI Engineer

Job Type: Permanent

Experience: 5+ Years

Location: Hyderabad , Bangalore

Notice Period: Immediate




Interview Mode: Face-to-Face(F2F) interview on this Saturday , 19th September




Role Overview

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to build, optimize, and productionize cutting-edge AI systems. The role focuses on backend AI orchestration, framework integration, model performance, advanced RAG workflows, and multi-agent systems to deliver scalable, production-grade enterprise software.

Key Responsibilities

AI Orchestration: Build, test, and optimize bespoke Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent workflows.
Core Product Integration: Develop integration pipelines to embed core AI models into client environments.
Technical Delivery: Own the technical lifecycle of AI applications from rapid prototyping to stable production releases.
Optimization & Debugging: Perform technical debugging, root-cause analysis, and latency and prompt optimization.
Best Practices: Implement engineering best practices for LLM evaluation, guardrails, and version control.
Risk Management: Identify and flag model drift, data leakage, and system risks at an early stage.

Technical Requirements

GenAI Ecosystem: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems using LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex.
Protocols & Frameworks: Strong understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), A2A protocols, and Agent Developer Kits.
LLM Engineering: Practical proficiency in prompting techniques, fine-tuning workflows, and evaluating LLM outputs.
Data Science Stack: Strong hands-on experience with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
Cloud & MLOps: Experience deploying and scaling machine learning solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
DevOps & Containers: Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
Backend Stack: Production-grade backend development skills in Python, with basic familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript for API integrations.

We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer with 4-12 years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in building and deploying production-grade GenAI solutions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI Agents, Python, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
The role involves designing end-to-end GenAI solutions, developing RAG pipelines and AI agents, integrating models such as OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, and building AI services using Python and FastAPI/Flask.
The candidate will work with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search and deploy scalable AI applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Responsibilities also include LLM evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, security, responsible AI, performance optimization, and taking GenAI solutions from POC to production.

We are seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to identify, develop, and implement AI-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency, automate business processes, and enhance decision-making. The role involves working closely with business stakeholders to transform ideas into practical AI applications across multiple domains. Key Responsibilities
Develop AI-powered solutions using modern machine learning and generative AI technologies.
Design and implement intelligent automation use cases.
Build proof-of-concepts, pilots, and scalable AI applications.
Integrate AI capabilities into existing business workflows and platforms.
Collaborate with business teams to identify opportunities for digital transformation.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications.
Support deployment, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Desired Skills
Experience in Python development.
Knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Experience with APIs and system integrations.
Knowledge of data processing, automation, and analytics.
Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Experience
4-6 years of experience in AI, software engineering, automation, or data-centric roles.
